comparison.objective: Lower an entire cable into a trench without edge contact, versus adjusting and testing an axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Deformable cable handling and clearance control, not rigid-tool engagement or force-limited collar locking.
comparison.success_condition: Cable fully deposited and released without touching the trench edge rather than two safe physical impact cycles.
comparison.reason: It tests deformable placement and collision avoidance, not adjustment or dynamic commissioning.
